description: Get a giftgenius.io link that opens the Secret Santa organizer with the spending limit, swap date, kind of group, group name and a note already filled in. On the site the organizer either shares one join link or types everyone in, names are drawn so nobody draws themself, and each person gets a private link that reveals who they are buying for, with room for gift hints. The tool saves nothing and draws nothing: the group is made in the person's browser when they press the button, and who drew whom is never returned here. No accounts and no email addresses are needed. Every field is optional.

date.description: The day gifts are swapped, as YYYY-MM-DD.

group_name.description: What the group is called, e.g. "Cousins' Christmas" (max 40 characters).

kind.description: The kind of group: family, friends or work.

limit.description: Spending limit per gift in whole US dollars (5 to 500).

note.description: A short note from the organizer to everyone, e.g. "Bring it wrapped, no gag gifts" (max 120 characters).

way.description: How people get into the draw: "join" (the default) gives the organizer one link to post in the group chat and everyone adds themself; "names" has the organizer type everyone in on the site.

name: start_secret_santa

filled.description: The details the link fills in, as the site will show them.

start_url.description: The Secret Santa organizer on giftgenius.io with these details filled in. Nothing is saved and no names are drawn until the person presses the button there.

title: Start a Secret Santa
